items.t: Said politicians in Montgomery have long talked about removing the state sales tax from groceries but have found excuses not to do it.

items.t: Supports universal school choice and education savings accounts (ESAs).
items.q: Alabama Gov. Kay Ivey and Alabama Lt. Gov. Will Ainsworth have given public support to universal school choice and ESAs.

items.t: Said federal military bases play an important role in the state’s economy and job climate and that he is working to retain and expand that footprint.
items.q: The federal military bases located in our state play an important role in our state’s economy and job climate, so we are making every effort to retain and expand that footprint whenever possible,

items.t: Has pushed the Pentagon to keep its commitment to place U.S. Space Command Headquarters in Huntsville.

items.t: Said improving the lives of service members, veterans, and their families has ranked high on his list of priorities as lieutenant governor.

record.t: Was chief architect and proponent of a $300 million reduction in the state sales tax on groceries in the 2023 session.

record.t: Was elected to a second term as lieutenant governor in 2022 without major party opposition.

record.t: Won a seat in the Alabama House of Representatives in 2014.
